about: Penticton sits on the bench between Okanagan Lake and Skaha Lake in British Columbia’s southern Interior. A channel and parkway join the two lakes through the centre of town, with beaches at both ends and vineyards on the surrounding benches. The city is a wine, fruit, and summer-festival centre for the south Okanagan. About 37,000 people live in Penticton.
seoSummary: South Okanagan city on the channel between Okanagan Lake and Skaha Lake, known for beaches and wine.
knownFor: Beaches on both Okanagan and Skaha lakes
Channel Parkway through the centre of town
South Okanagan wine and fruit country
